lines.en: label beachsixmakoto2:
scene clearnightsky
Night falls upon the second day like a tree falls upon the floor of the forest, where no one realizes it but me.
lines.zh: 夜幕降临在第二天，就像树倒在森林的地面上——除了我，没有人察觉。

lines.en: And it gets me thinking — how many more times would this need to happen before there’s nothing left to fall?
lines.zh: 而这让我开始想——这样的事还要发生多少次，才会再没有什么可以倒下？

lines.en: How long would we have to stay here, do you think? And would the novelty of spraying your seed upon nubile flesh wear thin like the fabric of cheap swimwear the longer you endure it for?
lines.zh: 你觉得我们得在这里待多久？把种子洒在年轻肉体上的新鲜感，会不会像廉价泳衣的布料一样，撑得越久越薄？

lines.en: If you asked me, I’d probably guess that you’d grow bored. But I also guessed that you’d grow bored of {i}all{/i} of this, yet we’re still here and we’re still talking.
lines.zh: 如果你问我，我大概会猜你会厌倦。可我也猜过你会对{i}这一整摊{/i}事厌倦，然而我们还在这里，还在说话。

lines.en: It won’t last forever, though.
lines.zh: 不过它不会永远持续下去。

lines.en: You know it won’t last forever, right?
lines.zh: 你知道它不会永远持续下去，对吧？

lines.en: So that makes me wonder — what will you do when it’s over?
lines.zh: 于是我忍不住想——等这一切结束，你会做什么？

lines.en: Settle down somewhere? Up north, maybe? Where you don’t have to deal with the heat anymore.
lines.zh: 在某个地方安顿下来？也许去北方？那儿你就不必再忍受炎热了。

lines.en: I hear Jesus is buried behind a yogurt factory in Aomori. You could always pay him a visit. Draw the forced parallels before realizing he was more like everyone else than he was like you.
lines.zh: 听说 Jesus 埋在青森一家酸奶厂后面。你随时可以去拜访他。先硬凑一堆相似之处，然后才意识到他更像其他所有人，而不是像你。

lines.en: Whatever you do, I know I’ll be there to see it. And when you close your eyes, I’ll be {i}there{/i} too.
lines.zh: 无论你做什么，我知道我都会在场看着。而当你闭上眼睛，我也会{i}在那里{/i}。

lines.en: You’ll see me in the water. In the mirror. In the sky and the sand and the stars or wherever it is you look because you’ll always be looking for {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: 你会在水里看见我。在镜子里。在天空、沙滩和星辰里，或者你目光所及的任何地方——因为你永远都在寻找{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: I’ll always be looking for {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: 而我永远都在寻找{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: And when the world goes dark, I’ll be the light that gives you warmth. Or comfort. Or anything you need because I would not exist at all if it were not for your unending love.
lines.zh: 当世界陷入黑暗，我会成为给你温暖的光。或是慰藉。或是你需要的任何东西——若不是你那无尽的爱，我根本不会存在。

lines.en: Which one am I this time, do you think?
lines.zh: 你觉得，这一次我是哪一个？

lines.en: Perhaps I should show you?
lines.zh: 或许我该让你看看？

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons1
There are {i}many{/i} things I should show you, if we’re being honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，我该让你看的东西有{i}很多{/i}。

lines.en: But for every single one of them, there are a thousand more I need to hide because your fragile heart could simply not endure the misery that I have.
lines.zh: 可每一样能说的背后，都有一千样我必须藏起来，因为你脆弱的心根本承受不了我所承受的这份苦。

lines.en: I learned from the best, though. And if the space between us can be filled by vagaries or auguries, I will tear open the floodgates and lay waste to the decaying crop field that is your conscience.
lines.zh: 不过我是跟最厉害的那位学的。如果我们之间的空隙能用含糊其辞或征兆填满，我会撕开闸门，把你良知那片正在腐烂的庄稼地夷为平地。

lines.en: Because I {i}still{/i} believe that you are here for a reason. Even when everyone else, including what’s left of yourself, has given up on you.
lines.zh: 因为我{i}仍然{/i}相信你在这里是有理由的。哪怕其他所有人——包括你自己残存的那部分——都已经放弃了你。

lines.en: There is a purpose for all of this.
lines.zh: 这一切都是有意义的。

lines.en: I just hope we can find it before we run out of infinities. Because it may not always seem like it, but time is of the essence. And I’m-
lines.zh: 我只希望我们能在耗尽所有永恒之前找到它。因为也许看起来不像，但时间至关重要。而我——

lines.en: : Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya？

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons2
: Hm?
scene makotobeachthreemoons3
: There you are. I’ve been looking all over for you. Why haven’t you answered your phone?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿啊。我到处找你。你为什么不接电话？

lines.en: : Does this outfit look like it has pockets to you, Makoto? My phone is in the room.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我这身衣服像是有口袋的样子吗，Makoto？我手机在房间里。

lines.en: : {i}Which{/i} room? Because that’s kind of why I’m looking for you.
lines.zh: : {i}哪个{/i}房间？因为这正是我找你的原因。

lines.en: : The...room we’ve been in since we got here?
lines.zh: : 就是……我们到这里之后一直住的那个房间？

lines.en: : What’s this about? Why are you looking for {i}me{/i} of all people?
lines.zh: : 这是要干什么？那么多人，你为什么偏偏找{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : Obviously because I’m inviting you to a super exclusive and super awesome slumber party.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为我要邀请你参加一个超级限定、超级棒的睡衣派对。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons4
: Because you’re one of the very few people in this city who doesn’t malfunction whenever the topics of the universe and time travel come up. And I think you could be useful to us.
lines.zh: : 因为你是这座城市里极少数、一聊到宇宙和时间旅行的话题就不会死机的人之一。而且我觉得你能派上用场。

lines.en: : You...intend to use me as a tool to fix the world?
lines.zh: : 你……打算把我当工具来修复世界？

lines.en: : Right.
: Gotcha. I completely understand what the slumber party is for now and why it needs to be tonight instead of literally any other night.
lines.zh: : 明白了。我现在完全理解这个睡衣派对的目的，也理解为什么必须是今晚而不是别的任何一个晚上。

lines.en: : Well...we’re already together, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 嗯……反正我们已经聚在一起了，不是吗？

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons5
: We sleep in the same building on the same floor. Just wait until we’re not in the middle of vacation if you want to abuse my status as Sensei’s dream girl to try and fix your timeloop.
lines.zh: : 我们住在同一栋楼的同一层。要是你想利用我「老师梦中情人」的身份来修你那个时间循环，等我们不是在度假的时候再说吧。

lines.en: : You know he’s coming too, right? I just got off the phone with him a little while ago since he actually keeps his on him.
lines.zh: : 你知道他也会来吧？我刚才还跟他通过电话，因为他还真把手机带在身上。

lines.en: : Well, so would I if I was getting nudes from cute girls all day. What’s your point?
lines.zh: : 换我一天到晚收可爱女孩的裸照，我也会带的。你想说什么？

lines.en: : My {i}point{/i} is this is the perfect opportunity for you to get closer to him and try to bridge the gap between you and the older Maya he still cries about all the time.
lines.zh: : 我的{i}重点{/i}是，这是你接近他的绝佳机会，好让你去弥合你和他一直为之哭泣的那个年长的 Maya 之间的鸿沟。

lines.en: : Bullshit. He can talk to me alone when he wants to do that. Why should I believe someone I’m competing against? Especially someone who competes as...{i}viciously{/i} as you.
lines.zh: : 扯淡。他想那么做的时候，自然会单独找我谈。我凭什么要相信一个跟我竞争的人？尤其是一个竞争起来像你这么……{i}狠{/i}的人。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons6
: There’s something you’re not telling me here. And I’m not about to go wandering into some room where you and a bunch of other girls can kill me just so you can climb up the rankings.
lines.zh: : 你这里有事没告诉我。我可不会傻乎乎走进某个房间，让你和一群女孩好杀掉我、只为让你往上爬几个名次。

lines.en: : I get not trusting me since the two of us aren’t particularly close. But you {i}do{/i} trust Ayane, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你不信任我能理解，毕竟我们俩不算特别亲近。可你{i}确实{/i}信任 Ayane 吧？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 并不，不信。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, can you come anyway? Because this all sort of hinges on your involvement and I’ll have stayed up all night for nothing if you don’t come.
lines.zh: : 那……你还是来吧？因为这事多少全看你参不参加，你要不来，我就白熬一整夜了。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不去。

lines.en: : Food will be provided.
lines.zh: : 有吃的。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 行吧。

lines.en: : Wow. You’d be really easy to kidnap if I was an older man with ulterior motives. Is {i}that{/i} how you fell into Sensei’s lap?
lines.zh: : 哇。我要是个别有用心的老男人，绑架你可太容易了。你就是{i}这样{/i}栽进老师怀里的吗？

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons7
: I did not {i}fall{/i} into his lap. He put me there. And it is there I have remained ever since — even in the face of time and a world that seems dedicated to tormenting me specifically.
lines.zh: : 我才没有{i}栽进{/i}他怀里。是他把我放上去的。而自那以后我一直待在那儿——哪怕面对时间，面对这个似乎专门致力于折磨我的世界。

lines.en: : What’s all this about tormenting you?
lines.zh: : 说什么折磨你，这是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons8
: Oh, Ami. We were just-
lines.zh: : 哦，Ami。我们只是在——

lines.en: : I’m not talking to you, Makoto. I’m talking to {i}Maya.{/i} She’s not supposed to be here.
lines.zh: : 我没在跟你说话，Makoto。我在跟{i}Maya{/i}说。她不该在这里。

lines.en: : Yasu told me the same thing. Why is everyone trying to get rid of me all of a sudden? I’ve literally just minded my own business all weekend.
lines.zh: : Yasu 也跟我这么说。怎么突然所有人都想把我赶走？我整个周末明明都只是在管自己的事。

lines.en: : Is that the “torment” you were talking about? Or were you insinuating something else, maybe?
lines.zh: : 这就是你刚才说的「折磨」？还是在暗示别的什么？

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons9
: Right. Well, I’m gonna go.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我走了。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons10
: Do you {i}have{/i} to? Because I {i}kind of{/i} don’t want to be alone with her.
lines.zh: : 你{i}非走不可{/i}吗？因为我{i}有点{/i}不想单独跟她待着。

lines.en: : I have one other person to go round up. And hopefully {i}they’ll{/i} be easier to track down. Just text me for more details in an hour or two if you change your mind about coming.
lines.zh: : 我还得去把另一个人找来。希望{i}那人{/i}好找一些。你要是改变主意想来，一两个小时后发短信问我细节就行。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons11
: Makoto, wait!
lines.zh: : Makoto，等等！

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons12
: Coming where? Did Makoto invite you to something?
lines.zh: : 去哪儿？Makoto 邀请你参加什么了吗？

lines.en: : I...she...yeah. I’m not going, though.
lines.zh: : 我……她……嗯。不过我不去。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不去？

lines.en: : Just...sounds kind of sketchy. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 只是……听着有点可疑。就这样。

lines.en: : That just makes it sound like you’re hiding something.
lines.zh: : 那听起来就像你在隐瞒什么。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : {i}Are you?...{/i}Hiding something, Maya?
lines.zh: : {i}是吗？……{/i}你在隐瞒什么吗，Maya？

lines.en: : What? No! Of course not. I trust you way more than {i}Makoto.{/i} I’ve only talked to her, like...three times. Max.
lines.zh: : 什么？没有！当然没有。我信任你远远超过{i}Makoto{/i}。我跟她总共也就说过……三次。最多。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons13
: Great! Then you and I can spend the whole night together while everyone else fights over my dad!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那今晚你和我就可以一起待一整晚，其他人就尽管去抢我爸吧！

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons14
: Why the long face all of a sudden? Is there something wrong with what I said?
lines.zh: : 怎么突然拉下脸了？我说的话有什么不对吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 一点也没有。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons15
Makoto Miyamura was {i}swarmed{/i} by colored lights as she walked along the coastline! Colors that must {i}mean{/i} something!
lines.zh: Makoto Miyamura 沿着海岸线走着，被彩色的光{i}团团包围{/i}！那些颜色一定{i}意味着{/i}什么！

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons16
Until they don’t. And you realize it’s all just a trick of the camera. A prank on your perception, leading you astray from the words on the screen when all they’ve ever been is honest!
lines.zh: 直到它们不再意味着什么。然后你才意识到，这一切不过是镜头的小把戏。一场对你感知的恶作剧，把你从屏幕上的文字引开——而那些文字一直都是诚实的！

lines.en: Just honesty comes in different forms. And while it may not take the shape of color or some other familiar distortion, it can {i}still{/i} be monumental when wielded by the right hands.
lines.zh: 只是诚实有各种形态。即便它不呈现为颜色或别的什么熟悉的扭曲，一旦被合适的手握住，它{i}依然{/i}可以是惊天动地的。

lines.en: But that begs to question — what about the {i}left{/i} ones?
lines.zh: 可这就不免要问——那{i}剩下{/i}的那些呢？

lines.en: Which gods do the gods worship?
lines.zh: 神明又崇拜哪位神明？

lines.en: Makoto Miyamura. Beach.
lines.zh: Makoto Miyamura。海滩。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons17
Yumi Yamaguchi! {i}Beach!{/i}
lines.zh: Yumi Yamaguchi！{i}海滩！{/i}

lines.en: Why is it always the beach?! I’m still reeling from the last time and you expect me to just go on and on like it’s nothing?! Is {i}this{/i} the perfect harmony you hoped for?!
lines.zh: 为什么每次都是海滩？！上一次我还没缓过来，你就指望我当没事一样继续下去？！{i}这{/i}就是你所期望的完美和谐吗？！

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons17
No! Don’t cut me off! I’m still not-
lines.zh: : 不！别打断我！我还没——

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons15
scene makotobeachthreemoons16
scene makotobeachthreemoons15
scene makotobeachthreemoons16
scene makotobeachthreemoons15
scene makotobeachthreemoons16
scene makotobeachthreemoons15
scene makotobeachthreemoons16
scene makotobeachthreemoons17
: Oh, Prez. What are you doing out here for? Shouldn’t you be, like...studyin’ or some shit?
lines.zh: : 哦，会长。你在这儿干嘛呢？你不是应该……在学习之类的吗？

lines.en: : That’s what you do for fun, right? I promise I ain’t tryin’ to be an asshole this time.
lines.zh: : 那就是你的消遣，对吧？我保证这次我不是来找茬的。

lines.en: : Maybe a few years ago. I have new ideas of fun now. And tonight, you’re lucky enough to be involved in one.
lines.zh: : 几年前也许是。现在我有了新的消遣。而今晚，你有幸被卷进了其中一样。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons18
: Yeah. {i}So{/i} lucky. Been here for a total of thirty fuckin’ minutes and I’m already bein’ roped into somebody’s bullshit. Beats workin’ at least.
lines.zh: : 是啊，{i}真{/i}够幸运。才来了总共三十分钟，我就已经被卷进别人的破事了。至少比干活强。

lines.en: : Go on, then. Tell me. The fuck you want? Somethin’ to do with more apocalypse shit, I’m guessin’?
lines.zh: : 那就说吧。告诉我。你他妈想要什么？我猜又跟那些末日破事有关？

lines.en: : Well, yeah. But how did you-
lines.zh: : 嗯，对。可你怎么——

lines.en: : Blondie had a god damn shirt shipped to my dorm room. You guys ain’t gonna make me wear it, are you?
lines.zh: : 金发妹把一件该死的 T 恤寄到我宿舍了。你们该不会要我穿上吧？

lines.en: : Only if you want to match us.
lines.zh: : 只有你想跟我们穿成一样的时候。

lines.en: : Wow, yeah. Sounds fun. So, when’s this shit supposed to happen {i}this{/i} time? We got time to, like...prepare and shit?
lines.zh: : 哇，是啊。听起来真好玩。那这次的破事{i}又{/i}该什么时候发生？我们有时间……准备一下什么的吗？

lines.en: : Well...we don’t know. And we basically {i}never{/i} know anymore now that the girl who was able to sense it is suddenly just a less useful version of herself.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们不知道。而现在能感知到它的那个女孩突然变得没那么有用了，我们基本上就{i}再也{/i}无从得知了。

lines.en: : However, I think that if we’re able to get her back on board, we might be able to-
lines.zh: : 不过，我觉得要是能让她重新加入，我们也许就能——

lines.en: : This shit you need to tell me now? Or can it wait until we’re all in the same fuckin’ room? Want at least a few minutes of peace and quiet if that fits within your {i}master plan.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这些破事你现在就得告诉我？还是能等我们所有人都到同一个该死的房间里再说？如果符合你的{i}宏大计划{/i}的话，我至少想要几分钟清净。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah. I’m planning on going into greater detail later, so-
lines.zh: : 哦。对。我打算稍后再细说，所以——

lines.en: : Cool. Watch the water with me then?
lines.zh: : 行。那陪我看会儿水？

lines.en: : ...What?
: ‘Less you don’t wanna. Ain’t gonna break my heart or anything if you say no.
lines.zh: : 除非你不想。你要说不去，我也不会伤心什么的。

lines.en: : You’re actually inviting me to join you? You’re not going to tell me to fuck off?
lines.zh: : 你真的在邀请我一起？你不会叫我滚蛋？

lines.en: : I might if you start bein’ fuckin’ weird about it.
lines.zh: : 你要是为此变得很他妈怪，我也许会。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons19
: I don’t have to be weird. In fact, I actually think this is a nice little moment of respite after an otherwise hectic day.
lines.zh: : 我不必变得奇怪。事实上，我觉得在忙乱的一天之后，这算是片刻不错的喘息。

lines.en: : Heard from Noriko that Futaba freaked the fuck out earlier and called out Sensei on bein’ a fuckin’ predator. Kinda pissed I missed it.
lines.zh: : 听 Noriko 说 Futaba 之前彻底崩溃了，还大骂老师是个该死的捕食者。有点气我错过了。

lines.en: : Even {i}that’s{/i} putting it lightly. She freaked out on practically everyone. And I get that she’s been going through some stuff, but...still. It was weird.
lines.zh: : {i}这么说{/i}都算轻了。她几乎对每个人都发作了。我理解她最近经历了一些事，可是……还是挺怪的。

lines.en: : Think she’s finally gettin’ tired of all this shit? Havin’ to compete with the whole fuckin’ class for the fake-ass love of some guy who doesn’t have any to give in the first place?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她终于厌倦这些破事了吗？为了一个压根就没有爱可以给的男人，跟整个该死的班争那份假惺惺的爱？

lines.en: : Could be. I think we all get days like that sometimes. That...{i}awareness,{/i} I mean. Just most of us keep it to ourselves.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。我觉得我们都会有那样的日子。我是说那种……{i}清醒{/i}。只是我们大多数人都把它藏在心里。

lines.en: : It does make you feel stupid when you think about it, though. I’m not really sure how things ended up like this.
lines.zh: : 不过一想起来确实让人觉得自己很蠢。我真不确定事情怎么会变成这样。

lines.en: : Guess I should be pretty proud of myself for bein’ the only girl around he ain’t porked yet then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那我应该挺为自己骄傲的，毕竟我是这附近唯一还没被他睡过的女孩，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re not the only one. There are a few still hanging on for dear life. I imagine you {i}will{/i} be the last if things keep going at this pace, though.
lines.zh: : 你不是唯一一个。还有几个也在死死撑着。不过我猜，要是照这个速度下去，你{i}会{/i}是最后一个。

lines.en: : That just makes it sound like it’s inevitable, don’t it?
lines.zh: : 那听起来就像是迟早的事了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Not really. What’s {i}inevitable{/i} is you giving into your feelings since I know you like him too.
lines.zh: : 也不尽然。{i}不可避免{/i}的是你会屈服于自己的感情，因为我知道你也喜欢他。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons20
: Don’t fuck with me, Four Eyes. You’re finally on my good side.
lines.zh: : 别耍我，四眼。你好不容易才站到我这一边。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to fuck with you, Yumi. You’ve really grown on me lately and I’m not trying to ruin that before we’re even friends.
lines.zh: : 我不是想耍你，Yumi。你最近真的越来越让我喜欢了，我可不想在我们还算不上朋友之前就毁掉这个。

lines.en: : I just feel bad that even in the midst of a timeline that likely won’t ever end, you won’t let yourself enjoy it.
lines.zh: : 我只是替你难过——哪怕身处一条大概永远不会结束的时间线里，你也不肯让自己享受其中。

lines.en: : Is that a loyalty thing? Or is your moral code just weirdly powerful when it comes to, uhh...{i}chronologically imbalanced{/i} relationships?
lines.zh: : 那是忠诚的问题吗？还是说你的道德准则在，呃……{i}时间上不对等{/i}的关系面前就是强得离谱？

lines.en: : So me not likin’ him just ain’t even a possibility in your head, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以在你脑子里，我不喜欢他这件事连可能性都没有，是吧？

lines.en: : No. I’m a little too smart for that, I think.
lines.zh: : 没有。我想我还没笨到那个程度。

lines.en: : Are you? Cause you weren’t smart enough to keep him outta your pants. You let him in the same way everyone else did, so you ain’t as special as you think.
lines.zh: : 是吗？你可没聪明到能把他挡在裤子外面。你跟其他人一样让他进去了，所以你没自己想的那么特别。

lines.en: scene makotobeachthreemoons19
: I didn’t do that because I’m dumb. I did it because I’m sad.
lines.zh: : 我那么做不是因为我蠢。是因为我难过。

lines.en: : Lots of sad girls ‘round here nowadays. And they’ve all got the same fuckin’ thing in common.
lines.zh: : 这年头这儿伤心的女孩多了去了。而她们都有一个该死的共同点。

lines.en: : Just trying to stay out of our ranks then, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以你只是想不加入我们的行列，是吧？

lines.en: : Just trying to survive. Better chance of that if I ain’t got any weaknesses.
lines.zh: : 只是想活下去。没有弱点的话，活下来的机会更大。

lines.en: : Fair enough. I still think it’s inevitable, though. And honestly? I’d be interested to see what a Yumi in love would look like. Even {i}if{/i} she were a rival of mine.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。不过我还是觉得那是迟早的事。而且说实话？我还挺想看看陷入恋爱的 Yumi 是什么样子。{i}就算{/i}她是我的竞争对手。

lines.en: : She’d probably just look like another dumb bitch. Ain’t you seen enough of those by now?
lines.zh: : 大概也就是又一个蠢婊子的样子。那种人你还没看够吗？

lines.en: : Do you think Noriko and Chika are dumb bitches, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Noriko 和 Chika 是蠢婊子吗，Yumi？

lines.en: : Well...they’re dumb. And they’re bitches. Probably wouldn’t call ‘em dumb bitches, though. So maybe you’re onto something here?
lines.zh: : 嗯……她们是蠢。也是婊子。不过大概不会叫她们「蠢婊子」。所以也许你说得有道理？

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe I am. And maybe one day, we’ll be able to talk like this without you holding yourself back.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许吧。也许有一天，我们能像这样聊天，而你不必再压抑自己。

lines.en: : I wonder what that’d be like?
lines.zh: : 我在想那会是什么样？

lines.en: : Exhausting, probably.
lines.zh: : 大概会很累人。

lines.en: : Yeah...probably.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概吧。

lines.en: : Punch me in the mouth if that ever happens, alright?
lines.zh: : 要是真有那么一天，就朝我嘴上来一拳，好吗？

lines.en: : I’ll try. I’m not much of a fighter, though.
lines.zh: : 我尽量。不过我不太擅长打架。

lines.en: : Yeah, and I ain’t much of a lover. So maybe we should just keep ourselves in line, then? I’ll figure out how to punch myself if I ever get soft.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也不太会谈恋爱。那也许我们就各自管好自己？我要是哪天心软了，我会想办法自己给自己一拳。

lines.en: : And I’ll continue fucking the guy you like. Works for me.
lines.zh: : 而我会继续睡你喜欢的那个男人。我没问题。

lines.en: : Aight. {i}Now{/i} you’re on my bad side again.
lines.zh: : 行。{i}现在{/i}你又回到我的黑名单了。

lines.en: scene black
: Heh...
: It was only a matter of time...
lines.zh: : 那只是时间问题……
